notes:
Adds OK and Cancel buttons to the Custom Site Settings window while keeping existing playlist and status actions unchanged.

Makes the Settings background fully opaque to match the Senderstatus prüfen dialog.

Adds a once-per-Kodi-session update check for IPTV playlist playback: the first Adult TV Test channel started through IPTV after Kodi launch checks for updates before continuing with normal stream resolution.

Additional IPTV channel starts in the same Kodi session skip the update check.

If the Custom Site was opened first, the IPTV session is already considered checked.

The existing Custom Site behavior is preserved: opening the Site still checks for updates every time.

Playlist, PVR resolver, Senderstatus prüfen, thumbnail and Landscape Wall behavior remain otherwise unchanged from v1.88.

This is an experimental pre-release and may contain bugs or incomplete features.
